notes.title: New Trailer and Release Date revealed!
notes.notes:
Hello guys!

Lenin - The Lion final trailer was uploaded yesterday to the Steam Page.
If you wish to watch it on YouTube, here is the link: Lenin - The Lion Final Trailer (2019)

Soon you'll be able to play the full game: September 27th.
Thank you for all the support until now and I hope you guys enjoy the trailer until the release date comes.

See ya!
